denominator_rule: complete calendar months within the requested interval that are covered by retained history (starting at the later of the requested-window start and oldest retained timestamp), divided by complete calendar months in the requested window. Shallow or truncated history yields a partial ratio when its retained span is shorter; v1 uses a history-dependent denominator and is not comparable.
